name: MPI
recent: MPI 近期完成了一项非关联方土地出售交易，并召开了第65届年度股东大会，所有决议均获通过。此外，EPF 在10月至11月期间频繁申报其作为主要股东的持股变动。
notable: 全资子公司 Dynacraft Industries 向 Open DC PE2 Asset 出售土地的交易已完成。
第65届年度股东大会于2026年11月4日举行，所有决议均以投票方式通过。
risks: EPF 在10月至11月期间多次申报持股变动，显示主要股东持股比例持续调整。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度，营收为7.366亿令吉，环比增长13.1%，同比增长30.6%；净利为4423万令吉，环比增长31.3%，同比增长1.6%；净利率为6.0%，高于上一季度的5.2%。

recent_en: MPI recently completed a non-related party land disposal and held its 65th AGM where all resolutions were passed. Additionally, EPF frequently reported changes in its substantial shareholder interest during October and November.
notable_en: The disposal of land by wholly-owned subsidiary Dynacraft Industries to Open DC PE2 Asset has been completed.
The 65th AGM was held on 4 November 2026 and all resolutions were passed by poll.
risks_en: EPF made multiple filings of changes in its shareholding from October to November, indicating ongoing adjustments in major shareholder holdings.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM736.6 million, up 13.1% QoQ and 30.6% YoY; net income was RM44.2 million, up 31.3% QoQ and 1.6% YoY; net margin was 6.0%, higher than 5.2% in the previous quarter.
